basis: Deming and Kahn (2018) inspired ten-category analytical layer; customer service and project management are combined; AI is explicit.

categories.definition: Reasoning, analysis, problem solving, and quantitative thinking.
Communication, collaboration, negotiation, and interpersonal interaction.
Reliability, adaptability, initiative, persistence, and self-regulation.
Writing, editing, documentation, and written communication.
Customer service, project planning, delivery, and stakeholder coordination.
Supervision, coaching, hiring, delegation, and team leadership.
Accounting, budgeting, financial analysis, and financial controls.
General digital literacy, office computing, data handling, and computer use.
Named software, programming languages, platforms, and technical tools.
Artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, and related tools or methods.

mapping_policy: A source concept may remain unmapped when evidence is insufficient. Do not force every ESCO or O*NET concept into an analytical category. Mapping changes require versioning and review.
